name: docdrift
description: Checks code against its design spec. A fast model (TypeSafe's Jev) screens every requirement in seconds; the agent investigates only what it flags. Java/Spring, JS/TS, Python, and any language by line range.

interface.longDescription: Does your code still match its design spec? After a change, a fast model (TypeSafe's Jev) screens every requirement in the spec against the code that implements it, in seconds and for fractions of a cent; the agent then investigates only what was flagged and tells you which side to fix, the code or the spec. Set up once per project with a spec map that pairs each requirement with its code. Java/Spring, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and any other language by line range. Needs uv and a TypeSafe API key (TYPESAFE_API_KEY in the environment that starts Codex).
defaultPrompt: Set up spec-drift checking for this project
Check my changes against the spec
Run a full spec-drift check before the release
